stories.title: WCS Sweep / Season Postmortem

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Two games, one run. That was the Cubs' October.

One run scored across both games. PCA and Bregman went 0-for-15 combined. Gausman battled and this team couldn't give him anything. The offense let this team down when it mattered most.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Rotation Rebuild from Scratch
stories.angle: Gausman, Boyd, Imanaga, Holmes, Peterson all departing. Remaining core: Steele, Cabrera, Assad, Horton midseason. Hoyer must build rotation from scratch. Framed as who STAYS (not transaction list).

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Hoyer's 2027 rotation, right now: Steele, Cabrera, Assad, and a midseason Horton.

Four arms. One returning from surgery. The rest of the staff just departed for free agency.

The market has to deliver — there's no other option.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: PCA NL MVP — Historic Season Survives the WCS
stories.angle: 45 HR, 40 SB, 10.4 fWAR — 7th 40-40 in MLB history, first Cub ever. Two quiet playoff games don't change the ballot. BBWAA votes November. Bold evening take.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong was quiet in the Wild Card. His ballot wasn't.

45 HR. 40 SB. 10.4 fWAR. Seventh 40-40 in MLB history. First Cub ever.

Two games don't erase a historic season. The BBWAA votes in November, and PCA is the NL MVP.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs
